name: kubectl
source: curated for hotdoc M2 (common ops only; kubectl >=1.27 syntax)

entries.title: List pods
entries.description: List pods in the current namespace. Add -A for all namespaces, -n <ns> for a specific one, -o wide for extra columns.

examples.description: List pods in the current namespace
List pods across all namespaces with node info

entries.title: List pods (official Kubernetes reference)
entries.description: Reference form from the Kubernetes docs — exactly matches `kubectl get pods` with default output. Mirrors the official kubectl-reference for canonical behavior.

examples.description: List pods in the current namespace

entries.title: List deployments
entries.description: List deployments in the current namespace.

entries.title: List services
entries.description: List services in the current namespace.

entries.title: Describe a pod
entries.description: Show detailed info about a pod including events (useful when a pod is stuck Pending or CrashLooping).

entries.title: Show pod logs
entries.description: Print container logs. Add -f to follow, --tail N for last N lines, -c <container> for multi-container pods.

entries.title: Run a command in a pod
entries.description: Execute a command inside a pod's container. Use `bash` or `sh` for an interactive shell.

examples.description: Open a shell in pod web

entries.title: Apply a manifest
entries.description: Create or update resources from a YAML/JSON manifest. Idempotent — safe to re-run.

entries.title: Apply a kustomize directory
entries.description: Build and apply from a kustomization.yaml directory.

entries.title: Delete a pod
entries.description: Delete a pod by name. Pods managed by a Deployment are recreated.

entries.title: Delete a deployment
entries.description: Delete a deployment and its managed ReplicaSets and Pods.

entries.title: Scale a deployment
entries.description: Set the replica count for a deployment.

entries.title: Restart a deployment
entries.description: Trigger a rolling restart of all pods in a deployment (recreates them one by one).

entries.title: Watch a rollout progress
entries.description: Block until the current rollout completes or fails.

entries.title: Show the current kubeconfig context
entries.description: Print the name of the kubeconfig context kubectl is currently using.

entries.title: Switch to a different kubeconfig context
entries.description: Set the active context. Affects every subsequent kubectl call.

entries.title: List kubeconfig contexts
entries.description: List all contexts in kubeconfig with the current one marked.

entries.title: Forward a local port to a pod
entries.description: Forward localhost:local-port to a port inside the pod. Useful for debugging services that are not exposed.

entries.title: Show pod CPU/memory usage
entries.description: Show CPU and memory consumption per pod. Requires metrics-server.
